findings.claim: MemCompiler defines per-step memory applicability using current subgoal relevance plus whether assumed environmental conditions hold; NOACTION=empty is a first-class compiler output when no memory reaches sufficient utility.
findings.scope: MemCompiler method; not an isolated gate ablation.

findings.claim: With Qwen-2.5-14B on ScienceWorld and the paper's deliberately minimal same memory bank, Full MemCompiler reports 46.67/69.33 completion/partial, w/o Brief State 38.50/60.67, AMMI static injection 27.93/52.68, and No Memory 31.11/45.26.
findings.scope: ScienceWorld Table 3. Same bank isolates delivery from curation, but dynamic compilation changes delivered memory/how and trajectories can diverge; not a fixed-candidate accept/reject-only intervention.

findings.claim: WorldEvolver exposes memory-conditioned foresight to a frozen downstream policy only above confidence threshold; otherwise F_t is empty. On ScienceWorld, selective foresight improves the reported w/o-F_t cells for both ReAct and ReflAct on Gemma-4-26B-A4B and GPT-5.4-mini.
findings.scope: AgentBoard ScienceWorld; online memories evolve and action trajectories may diverge, so not fixed-memory identity.

findings.claim: Xcientist treats blocked prepare as non-converged and re-runs prepare on a later invocation until reviewer PASS+complete+ready; cached prepare PASS is reusable.

At Xcientist step resume, stored hook/review/prefinish PASS can cause 'previously passed' skip before the current ArtifactRegistry and current deterministic/agent review hooks are built/run; the public test explicitly expects worker and reviewer to be skipped. The pre-skip predicate itself does not bind reuse to current plan/verifier/artifact digests.
findings.scope: Step-level replay predicate only; does not prove all downstream/global convergence paths miss every post-approval mutation.

open_frontier: Determine whether Xcientist phase-level/finalization logic revalidates current artifact bytes after a step_resume_skip; if not, reproduce a post-PASS artifact mutation and cached-skip path in executable public tests.
Find official MemCompiler code/evaluated revision and determine whether Table 3 keeps memory bank bytes/candidate universe exactly fixed across Full, w/o Brief State and AMMI.
Continue searching for a ScienceWorld or other scientific-domain intervention that fixes stored/retrieved candidate identity and changes only receiver-side applicability/admission.
Inspect SAMem primary implementation/artifacts for a state-processing-only ablation without relying on PDF text unless screenshots are used.
Continue RPMS official-code search; current public web search did not surface an official repository.

protocols.name: CACHED_PASS_REPLAY_REVALIDATION
protocols.rule: A persisted scientific PASS may be reused only if stored hook/review/contract PASS is still bound to the same plan-step digest, verifier revision, checked-artifact identity set, and artifact byte digests. Any drift invalidates reuse; conservative rerun is always legal.
protocols.test_result: 9/9 expected semantic outcomes; 9/9 cases structurally valid under Draft 2020-12.
